title: IVG Intense Salts Strawberry Sensation 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: IVG Intense Salts Strawberry Sensation blends the ripe sweetness of Strawberries with a cool Menthol edge. The fruit delivers a juicy, summer-like flavour that’s moreish, while the Menthol brings a brisk lift that keeps the profile clean. With a 50VG/50PG balance, this Nic Salt e-liquid is designed for consistent flavour, discreet vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, Strawberry Sensation works best with mouth-to-lung (MTL) pod kits, pens, and starter devices. Part of the IVG Intense Salts range, Strawberry Sensation pairs classic fruit sweetness with an icy finish for a simple, distinctive combination.
